newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates slip on lack of borrowing.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates slip on lack of borrowing.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates slipped on Tuesday on a lack of borrowing interest and the market closed with surplus funds, dealers said.
"Despite an outflow of 19.9 billion rupees on account of the auction settlement of short-term federal bonds, the overnight rates did not go up," a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Dealers said there was a lack of borrowing interest and the rates slipped to 3.0 percent towards the close from early deals of 8.0 percent.
